test_title: PYST 70: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

Will investors have perceived the subtle shift in policy?

options.text: Will the subtle shift in policy be perceived by investors?
Will by subtle shift in policy have perceived by investors?
Will the subtle shift in policy has been perceived by investors?
Will the subtle shift in policy have been perceived by investors?

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. Will the subtle shift in policy have been perceived by investors? .
